articles.summary: CINCINNATI --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Apr. 8, 2026-- American Financial Group, Inc. (NYSE: AFG) expects to release its 2026 first quarter results after 5:00 p.m. (ET) on Wednesday, April 29, 2026. The release will be available shortly thereafter on AFG’s website at www.AFGinc.com.
articles.title: American Financial Group, Inc. Announces Its Conference Call and Webcast to Discuss 2026 First Quarter Results

articles.summary: Net earnings per share of $2.29; includes ( $0.18) per share loss from after-tax non-core items Core net operating earnings per share of $2.47, an increase of 36% year-over-year First quarter annualized ROE of 15.8%; core net operating ROE of 17.0% First quarter Specialty P&C underwriting profit
articles.title: American Financial Group, Inc. Announces First Quarter Results

articles.summary: CINCINNATI --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Apr. 1, 2026-- American Financial Group, Inc. (NYSE: AFG) announced that it has declared a regular dividend of $0.88 per share of American Financial Group Common Stock. The dividend is payable on April 24, 2026, to holders of record on April 15, 2026.
articles.title: American Financial Group, Inc. Declares Quarterly Dividend
